research.title: Hyperspectral Band Selection With Dynamic Graph Enhancement and Hierarchical Feature Fusion
research.authors: J. Zhang, J. Wang, D. Li, Jun Zhang, X. Sun, and X. Shang
research.citation: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing (TGRS), vol. 64, pp. 1–16, Art. no. 5508816, 2026.
research.summary: Combined an autoencoder with a dynamic graph convolutional network to model nonlinear features and inter-band relationships, with hierarchical feature fusion for representative band selection.
details: Contributed to dynamic graph construction and adjacency updates based on joint spectral–wavelength similarity.
Conducted experiments on Indian Pines, co-wrote competition technical reports, and illustrated the graph convolution module architecture.

research.title: Optimizing Text Mutual Information as an Embedding Guard Against Embedding Inversion Attacks
research.authors: Y. Xia, Jun Zhang, and T. Liu
research.citation: Proceedings of the ACM Turing Award Celebration Conference - China 2026 (ACM-TURC ’26), pp. 218–220.

research.title: A Spectral-Adaptive GCN-Transformer Framework with Spatial-Spectral Feature Fusion for Hyperspectral Image Classification
research.authors: X. Sun, Jun Zhang, X. Lv, J. Wang, J. Zhang, H. Zhang, and X. Shang
research.summary: Developed a GNN–Transformer framework combining a spectral-adaptive, two-stage GNN for spatial neighborhood enhancement with a spectral-guided Transformer for nonlocal spectral modeling.
details: Designed static-graph aggregation, a spectral-difference graph mechanism, and an axial-aware feature fusion module to select informative neighbors and mitigate oversmoothing.
Used spectral tokenization, degree normalization, and self-loops to improve attention-based spectral modeling.
Independently wrote the methodology section and completed ablation experiments as part of a provincial undergraduate innovation project.

research.title: VPPO: A Post-Training Method for Vision-Language-Action Models Based on Video Priors and Preference Optimization
research.authors: T. Liu, Jun Zhang, Y. Xia, and H. Yao
research.summary: Studied post-training for VLA models using video priors, hybrid-loss supervised fine-tuning, and trajectory preference optimization with policy execution feedback.
details: Used separate supervision for continuous pose actions and binary gripper states.
Constructed preference data from simulated policy execution and combined trajectory preference optimization with supervised regularization.
